readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
The kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven while Rosa heard the hall clock strike eleven

durations: The piano played from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock, about 13 minutes
whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:47 by the kitchen clock and sat at Rosa's table
Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven
Madame's piano was heard beginning at 10:58 and stopping at 11:11 by the kitchen clock
Rosa heard the hall clock strike eleven
Madame had told Rosa to fetch Monsieur for the toast
Rosa went up to the atelier to fetch Monsieur
Monsieur was on the floor by his bench in the atelier, dead
Rosa came down the stairs from the atelier and screamed until Lina came out to her
At dinner, everyone was made to show their watches, and Rosa was in and out with the plates
Rosa is in the dining room for this interview
